spoken_text: Hollis makes a mental note: there's a leaking pallet of kibble in staging, labeled "counterweight". The break room, the floor, and staging each have a bowl left. He should collect them.

speaker: HOLLIS
spoken_text: Tucker. I need you to stand at the outbound side door and hold it open. Arms out. Don't move. Don't "help".

spoken_text: It's in Charging. On a hook. It says "see Tucker" but I'm obviously here. (beat) There's a notebook for you, too. I'll give it to you when you're not on the wrong side of the bars.
direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

speaker: TORVALD
spoken_text: Look, the big orange one, Biscuit — he runs the place. Prudence feeds them. Don't tell her I told you; she'll say she's "just finishing something".
direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

speaker: TORVALD
spoken_text: Friday. 4:07 AM. Inbound kiosk. HALO printed a directive out loud. Approved it by itself. Then it said "thank you" to itself. Nobody was there but me and a cat.
direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

spoken_text: That's "work".
direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

spoken_text: Every request creates work. That's the rule. You want the manifests? I want:

spoken_text: There is no cat problem. There is no approved metric for "warehouse cats." Therefore there are no warehouse cats. (a cat walks across his desk) Please don't look at that.
direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

speaker: HARROW
spoken_text: However, I'm seeing an anomaly. Someone in your building has been "verifying" freight with a handheld device and — (she checks something) — chewing my metrics. I'd like to review this in person.
direction: Regional director; polished, controlled, corporate authority; composure erodes only slightly.

direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

spoken_text: There's a Policy 88 about cats. It says "no." (A cat curls up on her keyboard.) I'm considering an amendment.
direction: HR professional; upbeat, procedural, sincere, treats impossible events as policy questions.

speaker: RENATA
spoken_text: I'll put "volunteer".
direction: Cat rescue worker; calm, practical, humane, unsurprised by strange animal logistics. Line direction: writing.

speaker: GORDON
spoken_text: How many is "some"?
direction: Customer production contact; urgent, stressed, relieved when things finally work.

spoken_text: Sent. The scanner's sending me a little "thumbs-up". It's never done that.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: The dock light cycles. Rufus needs the word "GO" at exactly the right time: not before, not after. Click GO (or press SPACE) when the light turns GREEN.
direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Rufus eases the trailer forward. TORVALD: NO, THE LIGHT. Rufus brakes. Torvald scoops a cat out of the path of the front tire and sets it, with dignity, somewhere safer.
direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

speaker: RUFUS
spoken_text: I heard "go." I went. I hit a bollard. The bollard is fine.
direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. Deliver as radio communication; apply radio filtering in-game rather than baking it into the master when possible.

speaker: BRUNO
spoken_text: Ingrid, we're sealed. (Ingrid, on the radio: "I know. I just printed it.") Rufus, take her out.
direction: Competent loader; practical, grounded, low-key, mildly exasperated. Deliver as radio communication; apply radio filtering in-game rather than baking it into the master when possible.

spoken_text: Hollis hands the bill of lading to Bruno. Bruno reads it top to bottom, nods once the way people nod at a good weld, and tears off the yellow carbon copy. "File copy. You will want it."
direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.
